title: Bash and running commands

body.text: run real terminal commands: npm install, run tests, git commit
— its strength is seeing the command's output; if a test fails, it reads the error and keeps fixing the code itself.

example: "'Run the tests and fix everything that fails' → run npm test → see 3 failures → fix the code → re-run until all green"

title: The fix-until-it-passes loop

body.text: This is the power of agentic coding:
act → see the result → adjust → repeat until it succeeds
— command it with a goal instead of steps, like 'make the build pass', and let it loop through the fixes itself.

example: "'Make npm run build pass with no warnings' — Claude loops through each error until it's clean"
